title: CIA-UAP-011, The Sary Shagan Weapons Testing Range
doc_notes: This document is a CIA Intelligence Information Report regarding the Sary Shagan weapons testing range in the USSR, containing details on missile systems and a single reported UAP sighting.

incidents.summary: Source observed a bright green circular object in the sky that expanded into concentric circles before disappearing.
incidents.location_name: Sary Shagan Weapons Testing Range, Site 7
incidents.quote: observed an unidentified sharp (bright) green circular object or mass in the sky
